name: Accoru
description_en:
Accoru is hosted small-business accounting software for quotations, invoices, vendor bills, expenses, banking and a double-entry ledger. Its useful unit of work is a business document and its payment, rather than an arbitrary list of accounting features.

This profile follows the documented quote-to-payment process and separates subscription billing from the free sample workspace. The vendor also advertises lifetime access, whose relationship to the subscription terms needs clarification. No account or payment was tested.
description_zh:
Accoru 是面向小企业的托管会计软件，涵盖报价、开票、供应商账单、费用、银行账户和复式记账总账。理解它可以从一张业务单据及其收付款开始，而不是堆叠会计功能名。

本文依据官方资料梳理报价到收款流程，并区分订阅和免费样例工作区。厂商还宣传终身使用方案，但该方案与订阅条款的关系仍需澄清。本文未创建账户或测试付款。

core_features.explanation_en: Accepted quotations can be converted to invoices; invoice lines support discounts and taxes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 已接受的报价可转为发票；发票行支持折扣和税项。

core_features.explanation_en: Chart of accounts, manual journals and a trial balance accompany document workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 业务单据之外，还提供科目表、手工日记账和试算平衡表。

core_features.explanation_en: Schedules can generate invoices, bills and expenses and send payment reminders.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可按计划生成发票、账单及费用，并发送付款提醒。

pricing.billing_basis: One business account; monthly or annual subscription, with a separately advertised one-time lifetime offer.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: $13 monthly or $124.80 annually ($10.40 monthly equivalent); $99 lifetime advertised, scope needs clarification; taxes extra.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 月付 13 美元或年付 124.80 美元（折合每月 10.40 美元）；宣传 99 美元终身方案，范围待澄清；税费另计。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.en:
The feature page describes branded quotations with acceptance links and conversion to invoices. An invoice can contain quantities, line taxes, discounts and shipping, with credit notes and write-offs available afterward. Customers can receive documents by email or use public payment links. These are related document states, not proof that sending an invoice collects the money.

For a hypothetical design job, start with an accepted quotation, convert its agreed lines, and record a partial payment. Inspect the remaining customer balance before recording the second payment. This is an evaluation example; the research did not create a document or confirm how each state appears in the interface.
sections.zh:
功能页介绍了带品牌样式、接受链接及转发票操作的报价。发票可包含数量、行税项、折扣和运费，之后还能处理贷项通知和核销。客户可通过邮件接收单据，或使用公开付款链接。这些状态互相关联，但发送发票并不证明已经收到款项。

以假设的设计项目为例，先接受报价，再转换约定明细并登记一笔部分付款。登记第二笔付款前检查客户剩余余额。这是评估样例；本文未创建单据，也未核对每个状态在界面中的呈现。

sections.title_en: Documents, cash and the ledger must agree
sections.title_zh: 让单据、资金和总账一致
sections.en:
Accoru documents bank and cash accounts, transfers, vendor balances, a chart of accounts and manual journal entries. Reports include profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance and receivables/payables aging. Recurring schedules also cover supplier bills and expenses, so automation is broader than sending the same invoice repeatedly.

A useful acceptance exercise is to enter a vendor bill, record its payment from a bank account and compare the vendor balance with the relevant ledger and report. Reconcile against an independent bank statement. Neither a balanced ledger nor a live dashboard proves a transaction was categorized correctly; the chart, tax settings and opening balances still need accounting review.
sections.zh:
Accoru 文档列出银行和现金账户、转账、供应商余额、科目表及手工日记账。报表包括损益表、资产负债表、试算平衡表和应收应付账龄。周期计划也覆盖供应商账单与费用，因此自动化不限于重复发送发票。

可用一张供应商账单做验收：登记账单，从指定银行账户付款，再对照供应商余额、相关总账和报表，并使用独立银行对账单进行核对。总账平衡或仪表盘实时刷新，都不能证明分类正确；科目、税项设置和期初余额仍需会计人员审核。

sections.title_en: Payment connections and currency have boundaries
sections.title_zh: 支付连接与币种各有边界
sections.en:
The feature page says users connect their own Stripe or PayPal account, payments go directly there and Accoru adds no payment fee. It also describes document currencies and base-currency reporting with daily exchange-rate refreshes. That does not establish processor eligibility, processor fees or settlement terms in a particular country.

Before relying on collection, verify the processor account, invoice currency, settlement account and treatment of refunds. The pricing page names Shopify, Zapier and Google Sheets, but this research found no setup-level evidence for their exact operations. They remain advertised connections rather than tested integrations in this record.
sections.zh:
功能页说明需连接自己的 Stripe 或 PayPal 账户，资金直接进入该账户，Accoru 不额外收取支付手续费；另有单据币种、本位币报表和每日汇率刷新。这些说明不能证明某个国家的支付账户资格、支付服务商费率或结算条件。

依赖线上收款前，应核对支付账户、发票币种、结算账户和退款处理。定价页还提及 Shopify、Zapier 和 Google Sheets，但本次未找到足以说明具体操作的配置级证据，因此只保留为宣传中的连接，不标为已测试集成。

sections.en:
The pricing page read on 22 October 2026 lists USD $13 monthly, or $124.80 charged yearly, displayed as $10.40 per month. The monthly plan includes one business account. Taxes are added at checkout. Annual billing adds priority support and early access in the displayed comparison. A $99 one-time lifetime option is also advertised.

The free live demo uses a sample workspace without registration or payment details; it does not establish an ongoing free business account. The terms page still describes monthly and annual subscriptions and discretionary refunds, without explaining lifetime scope. Obtain those conditions before buying lifetime access. The vendor’s comparison prices for other products were not adopted as independently checked facts.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的定价页列出美元月付 13 美元，或每年一次支付 124.80 美元，页面折算为每月 10.40 美元。月付方案包含一个企业账户，税费在结账时加收。展示的年付对照另含优先支持和新功能抢先使用。页面还宣传一次性 99 美元的终身方案。

免费实时演示使用样例工作区，无需注册或付款信息，不能据此认定存在永久免费业务账户。条款页仍只说明月订阅和年订阅，退款由厂商酌情处理，未说明终身方案范围；购买前需取得相应条件。本文没有把厂商对其他产品的比较价格当成独立核实事实。

sections.title_en: Small-business scope excludes several specialist jobs
sections.title_zh: 小企业记账范围之外的任务
sections.en:
The vendor’s own overview explicitly excludes payroll and built-in time tracking. It describes basic inventory rather than manufacturing, multi-location stock, kits or detailed SKU costing, and says there is no native mobile app yet. Mobile browser access is a different delivery method.

This makes Accoru worth evaluating for a service owner who needs documents and bookkeeping together, but a weak starting point for an employer seeking wage calculation or a manufacturer seeking production inventory. Those are editorial fit judgments from stated boundaries, not a comparative rating. Remove the old directory’s payroll and revenue-recognition assumptions unless a current source establishes them.
sections.zh:
厂商自己的概述明确排除了薪资处理和内置工时跟踪，库存定位为基础管理，而非制造、多地点库存、套件或细粒度 SKU 成本核算；文中还说明暂未提供原生移动应用。手机浏览器访问属于另一种交付方式。

因此，需要把业务单据与记账放在一起的服务业经营者可以评估 Accoru；若主要需求是工资计算或生产库存，则不适合作为首选起点。这是根据明确边界作出的编辑判断，不是比较评分。旧目录关于薪资和收入确认的假设已移除，除非新的官方证据能够支持。

sections.title_en: Prepare the books and check recovery before switching
sections.title_zh: 迁移前准备账簿并检查恢复方式
sections.en:
Start with business details, base currency, tax rates, document numbering, chart of accounts and opening balances. Invite the accountant through a separate role instead of sharing credentials. The product page describes administrator, accountant and viewer roles and an activity log; the terms make users responsible for their credentials and describe data export when leaving.

Try a credit note, duplicate import and a disconnected payment account in a disposable evaluation before migration. These are proposed checks, not documented guarantees about error recovery. The terms state an uptime aim and explicitly do not promise uninterrupted service. Export format, restore procedure, bank coverage and retention were not established here; hosted access does not answer those questions.
sections.zh:
先准备企业资料、本位币、税率、单据编号、科目表和期初余额。通过独立角色邀请会计人员，不共享凭据。产品页介绍管理员、会计和查看者角色及操作日志；条款要求用户负责保护凭据，并说明离开时可导出数据。

迁移前可在临时评估环境中检查贷项通知、重复导入和支付账户断连。这些是建议测试，不能当成厂商对错误恢复的保证。条款提出可用性目标，也明确不保证服务永不中断。本次未确认导出格式、恢复流程、银行覆盖和保留期限；托管访问并不能回答这些问题。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Lifetime access is advertised on pricing but not explained by the subscription terms read.
research_gaps.zh: 定价页宣传终身使用，但已读取的订阅条款未解释其范围。

research_gaps.en: Bank coverage, processor eligibility and fees, data export/restore, retention and integration operations were not tested or fully documented in the pages read.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试或从已读页面完整确认银行覆盖、支付账户资格与费率、导出恢复、保留期限及集成操作。
